title: Operations Maturity Model

scale.adoption_note: L-0 + L-1..L-5 numbering per dea-metamodel #214 (adoption pending ratification)

description: Operations Maturity Model — the parent operational assessment for enterprise operations: how the enterprise mobilizes capabilities, processes, services, people, resources, information, technology, governance and performance mechanisms to realize its intent and deliver value. Nine dimensions assessed through two complementary perspectives on every criterion — Current Operational Realization and Future Operational Readiness — with the operational transformation gap as a first-class result.
